_note: Ali's personal pronunciation dictionary (TK Voice). Turns written text into what Ali actually says, for training text and inference input. Three layers: rules (letter-level, e.g. ق→گ), words (per-word respelling or keep-as-is exceptions), context (words with more than one pronunciation; never applied automatically). Only status VERIFIED is applied; UNVERIFIED entries are left exactly as written until Ali's ear confirms them. Word keys are bare forms (no punctuation, no tanween); a word also matches after stripping one prefix (وبال وال بال فال لل ال و ف ب ل) when the bare form itself is not listed. Evidence: 'ear' = Ali's listening answers; recognizer counts are hints only (it misses many g). Rounds 1-3 ق answers were withdrawn (question misunderstood); ear evidence for ق starts at round 4.
